The heating reasoning belongs to JK-2002, whose THIN FILM moves at v < c_perp with horizons at c(x_h) = +/- v and T_H(v) = T_H(0)(1 - v^2/c_perp^2) rising to the NON-ZERO T_H(0) = hbar c_perp / 2 pi d as radiation slows the wall (bhbu.tex lines 507, 550, 596-616, 652-654). record.evidence: Re-verified from the full TeX source; the pilot is right. Balbinot-Fagnocchi-Fabbri PRD 71, 064019 is not a condensate result. Abstract: "an acoustic black hole formed in a Laval nozzle under the assumption that the motion of the fluid is one-dimensional". Sec.IV, acusticpap.tex line 540: "Let us further assume the sound velocity c constant" - Eq. (Tsonic) is derived from that constant-c profile. Sec."The fate of the acoustic black hole", lines 1021-1023, verbatim: "In a similar way one can treat sonic black holes formed by a Bose-Einstein condensate [garayvisser]. The major difference comes from the fact that the sound velocity c is not constant, but proportional to rho^(1/2). This will be discussed elsewhere." (The file is ISO-8859 encoded, so a plain grep silently returns nothing on it - use grep -a with LC_ALL=C.) FIXED in fe154d98: the label is gone from BHThermodynamicsFourLaws.lean, src/bh_thermodynamics/{__init__,acoustic_evolution,four_laws_data,falsifier_checks}.py and src/core/citations.py, and the scope that replaces it is stated positively in the Lean overview, the Balbinot2005PRD registry entry, the acoustic_evolution module docstring, src/core/constants.py and papers/L3/bundle_metadata.json apex claims. Blast radius beyond the filed locations: D3 Sec.6 and F both attributed T_H(v) = T_H(0)(1 - v^2/c_perp^2) - the Jacobson-Koike HEATING law - to Balbinot as the anchor for the COOLING branch, sourced from a SECOND registry entry, Balbinot2005 (PRL 94, 161302, gr-qc/0405096), whose provides read "BEC analog Hawking T_H(v) = T_H(0)(1 - v^2/c_perp^2) ... cooling-toward-extremality" with primary_source_path and doi_verified both None. Three wrong claims on an entry no held source had ever backed. Both drafts now name Balbinot for the cooling sign and Jacobson-Koike for the thin-film contrast, and that registry entry carries no equation-level claim pending acquisition of gr-qc/0405096. Also corrected: the shipped figure trace name, axis title and page title in src/core/visualizations.py (re-rendered into figures/, papers/L3/figures/ and papers/paper27_.../figures/), the review_figures.py caption, src/wkb/backreaction.py (whose condensate evolution is the project OWN computation - the 2005 papers supply the sign, not the condensate equations), tests/test_bh_thermodynamics.py, docs/roadmaps/Phase6a_Roadmap.md, docs/RESEARCH_STATUS_OVERVIEW.md, papers/D3/SYNTHESIS_BRIEF.md and the claims-reviewer bundle prompt that instructed reviewers to expect a condensate anchor.
